scripts.build:desktop: pnpm check && pnpm --filter desktop tauri build --no-bundle
scripts.package:desktop: pnpm check && pnpm --filter desktop tauri build
scripts.dist:desktop: pnpm check && pnpm --filter desktop tauri build
scripts.dist:desktop:linux: pnpm check && pnpm --filter desktop tauri build --bundles deb,appimage
scripts.dist:desktop:linux:appimage: pnpm check && pnpm --filter desktop tauri build --bundles appimage
scripts.dist:desktop:linux:deb: pnpm check && pnpm --filter desktop tauri build --bundles deb
scripts.dist:desktop:linux:tar: pnpm check && pnpm --filter desktop tauri build --bundles deb && cd target/release/bundle/deb && tar -czf ../Slopcast-$npm_package_version-linux-amd64.tar.gz slopcast_$npm_package_version_amd64
scripts.dist:desktop:win: pnpm check && pnpm --filter desktop tauri build --bundles nsis
scripts.test:unit: pnpm --filter server test && pnpm --filter @slopcast/shared-types test && pnpm --filter desktop test
